info.title: Eurex reference data tools
info.description: Read-only tools over the Eurex GraphQL reference-data API (products, contracts, trading hours, holidays, tick rules, TES parameters, settlement prices). Send your own key from the Deutsche Börse developer portal in the X-DBP-APIKEY header; it is forwarded to the Eurex API and never stored.
